skill_name: Give an example of how civil engineering can help a community.
workflow: Civil engineering can help a community in many ways. For example, civil engineers can help design and construct roads, bridges, and other structures for the community. This allows for an improved quality of life for the citizens by providing efficient access to different areas of the town. In addition, civil engineers can help devise efficient water and sewer systems, which provide clean and safe water for drinking and other daily activities.
